Class CrdbAgent

java.lang.Object
com.cockroachlabs.crdb.agent.CrdbAgent
public final class CrdbAgent extends Object
A minimal, dependency-light MCP-style facade over @AgentTool methods.

Build it from one or more provider objects with from(Object...), then use listTools() (MCP tools/list shape) and invoke(String, String) (MCP tools/call shape). Least-privilege by default: only @AgentTool methods are exposed, and destructive tools are hidden and rejected unless allowDestructive(boolean) is set.

A network transport (stdio/HTTP) is intentionally out of scope for this increment; listTools/invoke return JSON strings a transport can relay.
